evidence: The Modern Women's Area, located within the Vietnamese Women's Museum in Hanoi, Vietnam, serves as a vibrant testament to the evolving roles and contributions of women in contemporary Vietnamese society. This exhibit occupies a significant portion of the museum’s modern exhibition floor, where the narrative of Vietnamese women transitions from the traditional settings of incense-filled rooms and ceremonial weddings to the dynamic urban landscapes of today.
